capabilities: Import a Confluence space exported as HTML into the vault
Convert exported Confluence HTML to Markdown notes
Select a space folder from an import dialog command
extras: README marks the plugin as WIP ('use it on your own risk') and notes it only works on desktop, with a macOS-specific Pandoc path assumption (/usr/local/bin).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring in Confluence spaces exported as HTML.

relations.evidence: Under the hood the plugin uses confluence-to-markdown

summary: Confluence importer that converts an HTML space export into Markdown notes in the vault.
